verdict.rationale: Exa's homepage playground shows a category selector covering Full Web, News, Companies, Research, People and Financials, which matches the news and finance verticals in the story. The docs also describe custom indexes of 1B+ people, 50M+ companies and 350M+ publications. Missing for 10: any evidence of an images vertical, API-reference documentation of the category parameter (it appears only as homepage UI text), and independent or hands-on corroboration of category-filtered results.
